mapper.select:
select DISTINCT mmg.`name` gName,mmg.g_id gId,m.`name` mName,m.m_id mId,p.`name` pName,p.p_id pId, ppg.pg_id pgId,mmg.seq from m_menu_group mmg INNER JOIN m_menu m on mmg.g_id = m.g_id and m.status_cd = '0' inner join p_privilege p on m.m_id = p.m_id and p.status_cd = '0' and p.domain in (#{storeTypeCd},'9999')
inner join m_menu_group_community mgc on mgc.g_id = mmg.g_id and mgc.status_cd = '0'
left join p_privilege_rel ppr on ppr.p_id = p.p_id and ppr.status_cd = '0' left join p_privilege_group ppg on ppg.pg_id = #{pgId} and ppg.store_id = #{storeId} and ppr.pg_id = ppg.pg_id and ppg.status_cd = '0' where mmg.status_cd = '0'
and mgc.community_id = #{communityId}
order by mmg.seq asc
